svg.title: Layered vesicovaginal fistula closure
svg.desc: Separate mobilized bladder and vaginal layers permit tension-free closure with offset suture lines; interposition is shown as optional. Freshening/excision and the number of layers are individualized. The diagram does not show ureteral protection, tissue viability assessment or drainage. View: Bladder-vaginal septum, conceptual section. Scale: Conceptual schematic; not to scale. Units: No measured geometry; any dimensions are illustrative. Clinical review pending; no named clinician has signed off. Concept sources: EAU Non-neurogenic Female LUTS: disease management (2026 web guideline), https://uroweb.org/guidelines/non-neurogenic-female-luts/chapter/disease-management; access: official full text; Continence operations and fistula-repair principles; does not validate exact suture trajectories. WARWIKI original vector schematic; individual illustrator not recorded. No separate figure reuse license recorded; linked sources are concept references, not artwork licenses.

svg.text: Vesicovaginal fistula — tension-free, non-overlapping layered closure
cross-section of the vesicovaginal septum: mobilize widely, then close in layers with the suture lines offset
